title: Terrible Customer Service
review_text: If you have esewa account and living outside Nepal, Your account will be locked by automated password expiry in 6 mths. When you try to contact esewa to resolve this issue, this is certainly impossible (100%) because they have one of the worst customer service in IT industry. Never gonna use this platform again. IME Pay is 1000 times better than esewa.
